<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the carbonyl‑ene reaction (forward: carbonyl + alkene → alcohol + new C‑C bond, with C=O and C=C bonds broken and an alcohol and a C‑C bond formed). This will allow us to propose a single‑step retrosynthesis.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol", "C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
